attempts.rationale: Add 'httpx' to dev dependencies because the test suite uses pytest-httpx which requires the httpx module, but openai 3.0.0 no longer installs httpx transitively. This ensures the module is available for mocking, though further changes may be needed to make the openai client use the legacy HTTPX client for mocks to work.

The openai 3.0.0 release switched to HTTPX2, which breaks pytest-httpx mocks that intercept HTTPX v1 requests. Since the test suite relies on pytest-httpx for mocking and cannot intercept HTTPX2 traffic without significant test rewrites (which require access to test files not provided), the minimal stopgap is to pin openai below 3.0.0 until the test infrastructure can be migrated.
